card.name: Space before a dose amount
card.fires_on: The space just before a number that gives a dose amount, after phrases like "dosage of", "is", "dose of" or "up to". It is strongest in dosing sentences for injected cancer drugs.

modes.label: Space before dose number
modes.description: The blank space after "is" or "of" that comes right before a dose figure such as 30 mg/m2.
modes.example: The recommended dosage of pralatrexate injection is<< >>30 mg/m 2 intraven

modes.label: Space before count or level
modes.description: The space before a number of cycles or dose levels, or after "and" in a list of doses.
modes.example: of ≥ 30 kg: • 1,500 mg in combination with chemotherapy every 3 weeks (21 days) up to<< >>8 cycles followed by 1,5

card.writes: The promoted tokens are mostly the word "output", which does not clearly fit dosing text, so there is no clear output effect.
card.plain: It fires on the blank space that comes just before a dose number in a dosing sentence.
